entries.title: Automatic changelog updates
changes: The changelog refreshes upstream releases and SaaS notes without a separate page deployment.
SaaS code changes require a changelog entry in CI. Saved updates remain readable if a source is temporarily unavailable.

entries.title: DomBot 2.1.0
changes: Adds Unstoppable Domains registrar support and improves Namecheap domain details and request pacing.
Improves Afternic sales-history synchronization, sync error visibility and scrubbed desktop logs.
Available in managed portfolios as engine 2.1.0-hosted.1, with hosted compatibility and the existing account and publication controls.

entries.title: Bulk actions follow your current view
changes: Domains and Activity clear selection when you change filters or navigate away. Pagination and sorting within the same result retain your selection.
Bulk-action counts and targets use the same filtered scope, preventing hidden or stale selections from carrying into another view.
Managed portfolio browser tabs now use the domains.domains title.

entries.title: Clearer setup recovery and easier touch controls
changes: Setup pauses for reconciliation when a provider write has an uncertain outcome, with a safe reference for support.
Setup downloads now time out safely, so a stalled connection cannot leave setup waiting indefinitely.
Fixes touch targets around the Domains filters and presence inspector, and updates production dependencies.

entries.title: Password-change confirmation
changes: After changing your password, the password sign-in page shows the confirmation message and explains the next step.

entries.title: More useful renewal reviews
changes: Separates past reported expiry from upcoming renewals so domains that need verification have their own review workflow.
Excludes Gandi update timestamps from renewal deadlines and shows renewal quote age separately from inventory sync age.
Integrates the complete DomBot 2.0.0 core while preserving registrar connections for already-open browser tabs.

entries.title: Readable public domain links
changes: Published domain pages use a domain-based address such as domains.domains/working.io, keeping internal account identifiers out of the shared link.
Existing domain-page URLs redirect to the new address. Publishing remains an explicit owner action.
Public routing follows current publication and domain-control state.

entries.title: DomBot 2.0.0
entries.status: Upstream released · Included in the 4 November SaaS release
changes: Adds domain-control TXT verification, marketplace identifiers and optional GoDaddy API settings.
Improves domain action menus, mobile navigation and nameserver normalization.
The SaaS integration also includes the subsequent exact-currency formatting update.
